description: Source code defining an EmailObject class for parsing and extracting attributes from email messages, including handling of different email formats, attachments, and 'Received' headers.

classes.name: EMailObject
classes.description: Class for parsing email data, extracting headers, body parts, attachments, and processing 'Received' headers to extract IPs and hostnames.

methods.name: parse_email
methods.description: Converts pseudofile content into an EmailMessage object, handling different email formats.

methods.name: create_pseudofile
methods.description: Creates a BytesIO pseudofile from a file path or raw bytes.

methods.name: _msg_to_eml
methods.description: Converts a .msg formatted email into an EmailMessage object.

methods.name: _extract_msg_objects
methods.description: Extracts email components from a MessageBase object, including body parts and attachments.

methods.name: _build_eml
methods.description: Constructs an EmailMessage object from extracted components, handling multipart and related content.

methods.name: _update_content_disp_properties
methods.description: Sets Content-Disposition parameters on email attachments.

methods.name: generate_attributes
methods.description: Generates and adds email attributes such as headers, body, and metadata to the object.

methods.name: __add_emails
methods.description: Parses email addresses and adds them as attributes, including display names.

methods.name: extract_matches
methods.description: Finds all regex matches in a given text.

methods.name: add_ip_attribute
methods.description: Validates and adds a public IP address attribute if valid.

methods.name: add_hostname_attribute
methods.description: Validates and adds a hostname attribute if it appears valid.

methods.name: process_received_header
methods.description: Processes a 'Received' header to extract hostnames and IP addresses.

methods.name: __generate_received
methods.description: Extracts IPs and hostnames from all 'Received' headers in the email.
